purpose: Rapid paired ACT smoke for minimal component-wise temporal aggregation.

policy.postprocessing: Compose candidates after the native policy postprocessor and environment postprocessor.
policy.policy_rng_reset: Reset the PyTorch CPU and visible-CUDA RNG streams to policy_rng_seed before every method episode; use the same stream for every method on a paired initial state.

tasks.task_name: pick up the butter and place it in the basket
pick up the black bowl from table center and place it on the plate
put the bowl on the stove
put the black bowl in the bottom drawer of the cabinet and close it

method_semantics.fresh: Use the newest candidate for all seven dimensions.
method_semantics.official_act_temporal_ensemble: Use one full-action weight vector w(q) proportional to exp(-0.01 q), with q ordered oldest source to newest source.
method_semantics.cogact_shared_full_action: Use one full-action weight vector proportional to exp(0.3 cosine(a(q), a(newest))).
method_semantics.component_arm_fresh_gripper_act: Reuse the existing fixed component-aware control: fresh arm and ACT temporal-ensemble gripper.
method_semantics.groupwise_similarity: For each group g, use independently normalized weights proportional to exp(0.3 cosine(a_g(q), a_g(newest))).
method_semantics.groupwise_similarity_age: For each group g, use independently normalized weights proportional to exp(0.3 cosine(a_g(q), a_g(newest)) - 0.03 source_age(q)).
method_semantics.groupwise_similarity_age_gripper_vote: Use groupwise_similarity_age arm aggregation. For the gripper, classify nonnegative commands as open and negative commands as close, sum normalized gripper weights by sign, use the larger-support sign (newest sign on an exact tie), and return the highest-weight candidate with that sign (newest on an exact candidate-weight tie).

analysis.primary_comparison: Each new variant versus cogact_shared_full_action on the same task and initial state.
analysis.paired_outcome_unit: One initial state / seed pair; task-macro summaries are primary and pooled counts are descriptive.
analysis.meaningful_margin: Predeclare a smoke signal as at least +0.20 task-macro success rate over CogACT, while checking Goal 1 for catastrophic failure.
analysis.goal_counterexample_floor: A candidate is not leading if it loses all five Goal 1 paired episodes to CogACT or has a 0/5 Goal 1 result when CogACT succeeds on at least one episode.
